# write_blosc { #spikepack.write_blosc }

```python
write_blosc(
    path,
    *,
    times_seconds,
    labels=None,
    quantization_us=DEFAULT_QUANTIZATION_US,
    extra_meta=None,
)
```

Write a spike train to a Blosc directory shard.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name            | Type       | Description                                                                     | Default                   |
|-----------------|------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------|
| path            | Path       | Output directory (created if missing).                                          | _required_                |
| times_seconds   | np.ndarray | Sorted event times in seconds.                                                  | _required_                |
| labels          | np.ndarray | Per-event integer label (e.g. unit/cluster id), same length as `times_seconds`. | `None`                    |
| quantization_us | int        | Tick size in microseconds.                                                      | `DEFAULT_QUANTIZATION_US` |
| extra_meta      | dict       | Extra fields merged into `meta.json` (e.g. `source`, `recording_id`).           | `None`                    |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                  |
|--------|--------|------------------------------|
|        | int    | Total bytes written to disk. |
